findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 18 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 25 questions numbered 1-25; by section: 18.1 2, 18.2 2, 18.2.2 1, 18.3.2 1, 18.3.3 1, 18.4.1 1, 18.4.2 2, 18.4.3 1, 18.5.1 2, 18.5.2 3, 18.6.1 1, 18.6.2 1, 18.7 1, 18.8 1, 18.8.1 2, 18.8.2 3.

Theory parts cover the monohybrid cross and law of segregation, chromosomal theory and testcross, independent assortment as a source of variation and its limitations, co-dominance in the MN system, multiple alleles and ABO transfusion, the Rh system, complications of erythroblastosis foetalis, polygenic skin colour, gene interactions and the Bombay phenotype, detection of linkage, crossing over, karyotype and gametes in sex determination, X-linked dominant and Y-linked traits, clotting and haemophilia types, colour-blindness types, muscular dystrophy and embryonic screening. Numericals (product and sum rules, dihybrid, ABO, Rh, skin colour, Labrador, foxglove, X-linked cross) use new crosses, every fraction recomputed in Python. The exercise's long questions are not repeated. Book corrections followed (X-linked dominant traits commoner in females, 50% only for a heterozygous mother, W-carrying egg).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
